# Screenwriting Consultant

> Script notes, TV pilot notes, treatment analysis, logline punch-ups and career, deal and production advice from Matt Tabak, a former studio executive (Touchstone/Disney, Paramount, Warner Bros.), WGA screenwriter and director, attorney, and lecturer at Chapman University's Dodge College of Film and Media Arts. Based in Los Angeles; sessions by Zoom or phone.

## Key facts

- Developed the script that became Pretty Woman; bought and developed Face/Off; gave Se7en writer Andrew Kevin Walker his first screenwriting job.
- Developed 150+ projects and read 2,000+ scripts as a studio executive.
- Wrote and directed Auggie Rose (2000), released on video as Beyond Suspicion. Wrote and produced The Other Zoey (2023).
- Rates: feature screenplay notes $600; TV pilot notes $400; treatment analysis $350; logline punch-up $175; career, deal and production advice $195 first hour, $125 each additional hour.
